_comment: Advisories the npm audit gate (scripts/npm-audit.mjs) lets through: only ones with no fixed version that reach dev tools alone. Each entry needs a reason and a review date; the gate fails once a fix is published or the date has passed. §507.

advisories.reason: ReDoS in picomatch <= 4.0.7, no fixed version (2026-11-18). Reaches only dev tools (vite, vitest, svelte-check via tinyglobby/fdir); not shipped, and the patterns come from our own config. Dependabot alert #9 auto-dismissed as dev-only.
